name: nexuserp
description: Sitio corporativo y panel comercial de NexusERP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.start:local: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
